flows.title: Add alt text to an image in a post
steps: Create a new article, video or podcast post.
Upload an image from your device into the post draft.
Click the three dots in the upper right corner of the image and select Edit alt text.
Type a clear, concise description of the image.

flows.title: Add a callout block to a post
steps: Create a new article, video or podcast post.
In the editor toolbar, select the quotes icon.
Click Callout block and enter the text inside it. A callout block is a container that sets a passage apart from the rest of the writing.
